about_the_game:
▶︎ Story 

Gilda, Saret, and Aria, three extremely powerful high level adventurers accept a request during their expedition,

But are hypnotized by an evil person in the middle of completing the request.

The powerful magic talisman rewrites their common sense, and even though they were the strongest adventurers, they could only obeying their master's every command——...

▶︎ Game Synopsis

【Hypnosis-Induced Special H Events】

Heroines that are much stronger than you, become mind-controlled after making a couple of mistakes.

This work is an RPG that was made to be dedicated to the concept of mind-control.

The heroines are all very powerful, so there is no levelling system in this game.

【After Defeat】
The heroines might be mind-controlled and lose due to the player's actions.
But! It isn't simply GAME OVER after you enter the losing scenarios once in this game, instead you will enter an alternate BAD END route:

  • Become a zombie servant to the villain after being controlled, and defend the village that has also been brainwashed...

  • Go into training after losing, and get totally brainwashed into becoming a believer...

  • Get brainwashed into becoming the lowest level combatant...

Every BAD END has its own independent chapters, and players can enjoy all kinds of scenes!
※After completing the BAD END content, players can return to the previous route to play again.

【Other Key Features】
The game has various features.
This includes a "corruption state" that records the hypnotized state of characters,
and an "adventure encyclopedia" that describes the characters and the world-building in detail.
As well as a "conversation tool" that allows you to see dialogue.

The game also undergoes slight changes when you enter BAD END routes.
Skills and equipment might change, and the shop could begin to sell items and clues related to the alternate route.

 ▶︎ Event synopsis 

  • Explore the town while brainwashed

  • Walk naked through the streets

  • Receive a card that answers any question you have

  • Go undercover and investigate a clinic run almost exclusively by beautiful women, but find that their real job is...?

▶︎ Character Introduction

【Shirakawa Gilda】

Birthplace: Fire Kingdom (grew up in the Ayami district)

Measurements: 163cm, 49kg, B82, W56, H80

A girl who witnessed her parents get killed as a child,

and was rescued in the nick of time by a female paladin who heard her cries.

She wanted to become like her savior,

and after she grew up, set out on a path to help everyone unselfishly.

【Rokudo Saret】

Birthplace: Imaria district

Measurements: 171cm, 59kg, B92, W60, H84

A girl born in the land of mages that was long-rumored to be destroyed,

who was cast out of her homeland for having mana that was too powerful.

Her despondent soul was saved by Gilda,

and set out on an adventure alongside the two companions that had become

her kin.

【Getsujo Aria】

Birthplace: Whispered Kingdom

Measurements: 159cm, 51kg, B77, W59, H88

She was originally the 3rd princess of the Whispered Kingdom,

But is currently being declared dead.

Travelling with Gilda and Saret as a normal adventurer,

while secretly getting rid of threats to the Whispered Kingdom in service to

her homeland.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains non-consensual sexual acts, sexual harassment, brainwashing-related sexual content, interspecies intercourse, and BDSM.
